Small follow-up: wire the deferred "guest residency ending" Inbox trigger in InkOS. Project at /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/InkOS.

**Context:**
The Inbox v2 agent deferred this trigger because `studio_members.ends_at` didn't exist. A follow-up Dato migration (`20260422110200_studio_members_residency_dates.sql`) added `ends_at timestamptz NULL` and `residency_started_at timestamptz NULL` to `studio_members`. The types were updated in [lib/supabase/types.ts]. Now wire the trigger.

**Read first:**
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md)
- [app/(app)/inbox/page.tsx] — aggregator; look for how other triggers (e.g., missed call, low inventory, booking conflict) are composed. The Inbox v2 agent left a TODO comment for guest residency somewhere — find it.
- [lib/inbox/urgency.ts] — tier assignment logic
- [components/inbox/InboxItemRow.tsx] — row rendering for each `kind`

**Build:**

### 1. Server-side trigger in `app/(app)/inbox/page.tsx`
Add a new parallel query to the existing Promise.all fan-out:
- SELECT studio_members.* + artists (join via profile_id if needed to get display_name) WHERE studio_id=? AND role='guest_artist' AND ends_at IS NOT NULL AND ends_at BETWEEN now() AND now() + INTERVAL '7 days'
- Also compute open slots during the remaining residency window (for the audit's "open slots remain" sub-check). For v1, skip the "open slots" check — just surface every ending residency. Add TODO for open-slots computation.

### 2. Add `kind: 'guest-residency-ending'` to the Inbox item union
In whichever type file owns `InboxItemKind` (likely [lib/supabase/types.ts] + [components/inbox/InboxItemRow.tsx] has `ExtendedInboxItemKind` fallback). Add the new literal.

### 3. Map to urgency tier in [lib/inbox/urgency.ts]
- If `ends_at - now() <= 48h` → **TODAY** (amber) tier with MED priority
- Else → **THIS WEEK** (accent) tier

### 4. Row render — icon, CTA, action
In [components/inbox/InboxItemRow.tsx]:
- Icon: a calendar/person icon in Rust (or sky per existing pattern — choose consistent with bookings category)
- Title: "{Artist name} · Guest residency ending in {N} days"
- Subtitle: "Ends {ends_at formatted} · Market remaining slots"
- CTA label: "Market slots"
- CTA action: for v1, simple navigate to `/calendar?artist_id={X}&from=today&to={ends_at}` — owner can see the remaining open slots and manually post-market them. Log a TODO to integrate with marketing campaigns.

### 5. Auto-resolve
Resolves naturally when ends_at passes (past residencies don't match the query). Mark resolved_at on `inbox_assignments` if the user explicitly archives/dismisses.

### Brand
- Four colors, no raw hex
- Rust for Today tier, accent for This Week tier
- Zero `any`, zero `console.log`

### Verification
1. `pnpm typecheck` — zero new errors
2. `pnpm build` — passes
3. Manual: if test data has a guest artist with `ends_at` set 3 days out, a row renders under THIS WEEK tier with "Market slots" action

### Out of scope
- Open-slots computation (TODO)
- Full marketing integration (navigate-only)
- Notification to the guest artist (v2)

1	/**
2	 * Urgency computation for inbox items.
3	 *
4	 * Rules:
5	 *   now       — deposit pending for booking < 24h away; form unsigned for booking < 24h away
6	 *   today     — pending bookings in next 48h; waitlist signups < 24h old
7	 *   this_week — new clients < 7d ago (not yet booked); consent forms unsigned > 24h
8	 *   later     — everything else
9	 */
10	
11	import type { InboxItemType } from '@/components/inbox/InboxClient'
12	
13	export type Urgency = 'now' | 'today' | 'this_week' | 'later'
14	
15	export interface UrgencyMeta {
16	  label: string
17	  /** Tailwind text colour class */
18	  textClass: string
19	  /** Tailwind bg colour class for the dot */
20	  dotClass: string
21	  /** Tailwind border colour class for the group header */
22	  borderClass: string
23	}
24	
25	export const URGENCY_META: Record<Urgency, UrgencyMeta> = {
26	  now: {
27	    label: 'Now',
28	    textClass: 'text-red-500 dark:text-red-400',
29	    dotClass: 'bg-red-500',
30	    borderClass: 'border-red-500/20',
31	  },
32	  today: {
33	    label: 'Today',
34	    textClass: 'text-amber-500 dark:text-amber-400',
35	    dotClass: 'bg-amber-500',
36	    borderClass: 'border-amber-500/20',
37	  },
38	  this_week: {
39	    label: 'This Week',
40	    textClass: 'text-blue-500 dark:text-blue-400',
41	    dotClass: 'bg-blue-500',
42	    borderClass: 'border-blue-500/20',
43	  },
44	  later: {
45	    label: 'Later',
46	    textClass: 'text-muted-foreground',
47	    dotClass: 'bg-muted-foreground/40',
48	    borderClass: 'border-border/30',
49	  },
50	}
51	
52	export const URGENCY_ORDER: Urgency[] = ['now', 'today', 'this_week', 'later']
53	
54	export interface InboxItemForUrgency {
55	  type: InboxItemType
56	  /** ISO timestamp of the item itself (created_at or updated_at) */
57	  timestamp: string
58	  /** For deposit / form items: the booking's scheduled_at — ISO string */
59	  scheduledAt?: string | null
60	}
61	
62	/**
63	 * Compute urgency for a single inbox item.
64	 * All comparisons are client-side from `Date.now()`.
65	 */
66	export function computeUrgency(item: InboxItemForUrgency): Urgency {
67	  const now = Date.now()
68	  const h24 = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000
69	  const h48 = 48 * 60 * 60 * 1000
70	  const d7 = 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000
71	
72	  const itemAge = now - new Date(item.timestamp).getTime()
73	
74	  if (item.type === 'deposit') {
75	    if (item.scheduledAt) {
76	      const msUntil = new Date(item.scheduledAt).getTime() - now
77	      if (msUntil >= 0 && msUntil < h24) return 'now'
78	      if (msUntil >= 0 && msUntil < h48) return 'today'
79	    }
80	    return 'later'
81	  }
82	
83	  if (item.type === 'form') {
84	    if (item.scheduledAt) {
85	      const msUntil = new Date(item.scheduledAt).getTime() - now
86	      if (msUntil >= 0 && msUntil < h24) return 'now'
87	    }
88	    // Form unsigned for >24h → this_week
89	    if (itemAge > h24) return 'this_week'
90	    return 'today'
91	  }
92	
93	  if (item.type === 'waitlist') {
94	    // Signups < 24h → today
95	    if (itemAge < h24) return 'today'
96	    return 'later'
97	  }
98	
99	  if (item.type === 'client') {
100	    // New clients < 7d → this_week
101	    if (itemAge < d7) return 'this_week'
102	    return 'later'
103	  }
104	
105	  return 'later'
106	}
